verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਰਪਨ ਸੂਧੋ ਸੁਧ ਮੁਖ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ  ਉਲਟ ਕੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਮੁਖ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਭਇਆਨ ਸੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dharapan soodho sudh mukh dhekheeat  ulaT kai dhekhai mukh dhekheeaai bhiaan so ||

en.bdb: Just as the image is real when the mirror is held straight and it becomes aberrated, when the mirror is held upside down. The face looks awful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਤਾਹੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਲਾਗੈ  ਕੌਰਕ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਉਰ ਬਾਨ ਸੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: madhur bachan taahee rasanaa sai piaaro laagai  kauarak sabadh sun laagai ur baan so ||

en.bdb: Just as sweet words uttered by tongue feel loving to the ears, but bitter words said with the same tongue hurt like arrow.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਨੋ ਖਾਤ ਗਾਤ ਪੁਸ਼ਟ ਮਿਸ਼ਟ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਮੁਖ  ਪੋਸਤ ਕੈ ਪੀਏ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮਸਾਨ ਸੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dhaano khaat gaat pushaT mishaT savaiaadh mukh  posat kai pe'ee dhukh biaapat masaan so ||

en.bdb: Just as food eaten with the mouth leaves a good taste in the mouth and if poppy extract is consumed with the same mouth, it is distressing and one gets feeling of near death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਸ੍ਵਭਾਵ ਚਕਈ ਚਕੋਰ  ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਮਤ ਸਹਨ ਸੀਲ ਭਾਨੁ ਸੋ ॥੬੪੪॥
verses.translit_en: taise bhirat ni(n)dhak savaibhaav chakiee chakor  satigur samat sahan seel bhaan so ||644||

en.bdb: Similarly, a true servant of the True Guru and a slander are like the Chakvi and Chakor (Chakvi longs for the light of the sun while a Chakor desires setting of the sun). The True Guru's nature is like a sun that provides light to all equally. (644)
